title: Analysis of allele-specific gene expression in total RNA from blood lymphocytes
description: Recently a genome of Russian individual (somatic DNA from blood) was sequenced (Skryabin et al. 2009). That study was continued to find a linkage between genetic differences in parental alleles and bias in biallelic expression of genes.

samples.title: RG1
samples.description: Russian male (patient with renal cell carcinoma from the Blokhin cancer research center of RAMS).

runs.experiment_title: Illumina Genome Analyzer II sequencing: Total blood RNA sequencing of RG1 on Illumina Genome Analyzer II
